title: 没有考勤记录的员工
objective: 用左连接保留员工，并筛出没有任何考勤明细的员工。
statement: 找出没有任何考勤记录的员工，依次输出 employee_id（employees.id）和 employee_name（employees.name）。每名员工一行；如果所有员工都有考勤，返回零行。
knowledge: employees 放在 LEFT JOIN 左侧，确保每名员工先被保留；attendances.employee_id = employees.id 用于寻找考勤记录。
某员工可有多条考勤，匹配到的明细会展开为多行；本题只找完全没有匹配的员工，所以不会把有多条考勤的人重复输出。
未匹配时 attendance 主键 a.id 被补成 SQL NULL，可在连接后用 WHERE a.id IS NULL 识别。主键不可能是真实 NULL；过滤右表条件应放在 WHERE 才表达未匹配检测。
starterSql: -- 找出没有任何考勤记录的员工。

hints.text: 保留员工表的所有人，再从连接结果中挑出没有对应考勤记录的人。
LEFT JOIN 用 ON a.employee_id = e.id 配对；右表主键 a.id 未匹配时为 NULL，再用 WHERE a.id IS NULL 筛选。
SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name FROM employees AS e LEFT JOIN attendances AS a ON ____ WHERE ____;

referenceSolutions.sql: SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name FROM employees AS e LEFT JOIN attendances AS a ON a.employee_id = e.id WHERE a.id IS NULL;
referenceSolutions.explanation: 左连接保留每名员工，并按员工编号找考勤。没有明细的行中 a.id 是连接补出的 NULL，WHERE 只留下这些员工；有多条考勤的员工都不符合“没有任何记录”。

expectedFailures.sql: SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name FROM employees AS e JOIN attendances AS a ON a.employee_id = e.id WHERE a.id IS NULL;
SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name FROM employees AS e LEFT JOIN attendances AS a ON a.employee_id = e.id AND a.id IS NULL;
SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name FROM employees AS e LEFT JOIN attendances AS a ON a.employee_id = e.id;
